text: Ryan Lanyon, Manager, Strategic Policy and Innovation, Transportation Services will give a presentation on Automated Micro-utility Devices - Accessibility Feedback. As directed by Toronto City Council, staff are conducting a study by consulting with and engaging stakeholders, on the potential impacts and benefits arising from the use of micro-utility devices, and have also conducted a Transportation Innovation Challenge. The presentation will give an update on these initiatives and seek accessibility feedback from the Committee.

The Toronto Accessibility Advisory Committee: 1. Deferred the consideration of the item to the next meeting of Toronto Accessibility Advisory Committee on June 13, 2022, or to a special meeting called by the Vice Chair.
